title: Evidence
description: The artefact a claim rests on. Content-addressed and immutable. Byte-identical re-use across subjects is therefore detectable by construction, which is how evidence recycling is caught.

document_kind.description: Set when evidence_type is document_scan. Registration certificates and other identity documents are ALWAYS restricted scope.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the artefact bytes. The storage key is derived from this; identical bytes produce identical keys and are not duplicated.

perceptual_hash.description: For near-duplicate detection, where the artefact is an image.

storage_ref.description: An opaque storage reference. NEVER a fetchable URL, and never returned to a caller that is not authorised for the artefact itself.

redaction.description: Personal data encountered on an artefact is routed to its legitimate controller or discarded — never stored in the IDauto record. This field records that a redaction was applied.

erased.description: Tombstone. Set when the artefact was erased under a data-protection obligation. The Evidence record survives so history has no silent gap.
